message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-09-09 05:10 IST to 2026-09-10 05:10 IST (2026-09-08 23:40 UTC to 2026-09-09 23:40 UTC)

This primary scan combined and deduplicated only `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt`; `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read. Eight relevant vulnerability groups were verified. The highest-priority items are actively exploited Windows and Chrome vulnerabilities, followed by the large SQL Server, Adobe Acrobat/Reader, and Photoshop security releases.

### Findings

#### 1. Microsoft Windows: September update, including two exploited zero-days

- **Affected product/component:** Windows 10 and Windows Server, including monitored Windows Server 2012 R2
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-81963 (Windows Update Stack elevation of privilege) and CVE-2026-85880 (Windows ALPC elevation of privilege)
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 7.8 for both
- **Description:** Both flaws allow a local authenticated attacker to elevate privileges, and Microsoft reports active exploitation.
- **Why relevant:** Windows 10 and Windows Server 2012 R2 are explicitly monitored; CVE-2026-85880's affected-product data explicitly includes both.
- **Sources:** [JPCERT/CC September Microsoft alert](https://www.jpcert.or.jp/m/at/2026/at260025.html), [Microsoft September security update](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/msrc/blog/2026/09/202609-security-update)

#### 2. Microsoft SQL Server: September security update

- **Affected product/component:** Microsoft SQL Server, including SQL Server 2019, 2022, and 2025 update tracks
- **Issue:** Large CVE set covering remote code execution, elevation of privilege, information disclosure, security-feature bypass, and denial of service; examples include CVE-2026-67380, CVE-2026-67385, CVE-2026-67631, and CVE-2026-68775
- **Severity:** High, up to CVSS 8.8 in the verified records
- **Description:** Microsoft released security builds addressing numerous SQL Server vulnerabilities, many of which could let an authenticated network user execute code or gain privileges.
- **Why relevant:** MSSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and SQL Server Management Studio appear in the combined inventory.
- **Source:** [Microsoft SQL Server 2019 security update KB5122773](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/servicing/sql/sql-server-2019/general-distribution-release/5122773)

#### 3. Microsoft .NET and Visual Studio: September security update

- **Affected product/component:** .NET Framework and Visual Studio
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-69522 (remote code execution) and CVE-2026-62886 (elevation of privilege)
- **Severity:** CVE-2026-69522 is High, CVSS 8.8; CVE-2026-62886 severity was not clearly stated in the reviewed Microsoft support page
- **Description:** The update fixes a .NET/Visual Studio memory-safety issue that can lead to remote code execution and a separate privilege-escalation flaw.
- **Why relevant:** Microsoft .NET, .NET Framework, ASP.NET, and Visual Studio are all present in the monitored inventory.
- **Source:** [Microsoft .NET Framework security rollup KB5126147](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/servicing/dotnetframework/2026/09/september-8-2026-security-and-quality-rollup-for-net-framework-3-5-4-6-2-4-7-4-7-1-4-7-2-4-8-for-win)

#### 4. Microsoft Office 2016: September security updates

- **Affected product/component:** Microsoft Office 2016, including Access, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Publisher, and shared Office components
- **Issue:** Multiple CVEs; confirmed examples include CVE-2026-69778 and CVE-2026-69529 for Access remote code execution
- **Severity:** High, up to CVSS 8.8 in the reviewed records
- **Description:** Microsoft issued a broad Office update set addressing remote-code-execution and other vulnerabilities, commonly requiring a user to open crafted content.
- **Why relevant:** Microsoft Office and Office Professional Plus 2016 are explicitly monitored.
- **Sources:** [Microsoft Office September 2026 update index](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/servicing/office/5127194), [Office 2016 KB5002913](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/servicing/office/hotfix/5002913)

#### 5. Google Chrome 153: multiple vulnerabilities, one exploited

- **Affected product/component:** Chrome before 153.0.8010.36/.37 on Windows/macOS and before 153.0.8010.36 on Linux
- **Issue:** 230 security fixes, including CVE-2026-87491, an out-of-bounds write in V8
- **Severity:** The vendor rates CVE-2026-87491 Medium; the release also contains multiple Critical and High issues
- **Description:** A crafted webpage could exploit the V8 flaw to execute code inside Chrome's sandbox. Google states that an exploit for CVE-2026-87491 exists in the wild.
- **Why relevant:** Google Chrome is explicitly monitored.
- **Sources:** [Google Chrome release](https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/09/), [CERT-In CIVN-2026-0450](https://www.cert-in.org.in/s2cMainServlet?VLCODE=CIVN-2026-0450&pageid=PUBVLNOTES01)

#### 6. Adobe Acrobat and Reader: APSB26-141

- **Affected product/component:** Adobe Acrobat and Acrobat Reader on Windows and macOS
- **Issue:** 32 CVEs, including CVE-2026-81996, CVE-2026-81994, CVE-2026-81983, and CVE-2026-79907
- **Severity:** Critical and Important; highest CVSS score 8.8
- **Description:** The bulletin addresses arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file read/write, memory exposure, and denial of service. Adobe reports no known in-the-wild exploitation.
- **Why relevant:** Adobe Acrobat and Adobe Acrobat Reader DC are explicitly monitored.
- **Source:** [Adobe APSB26-141](https://helpx.adobe.com/ie/security/products/acrobat/apsb26-141.html)

#### 7. Adobe Photoshop: APSB26-130

- **Affected product/component:** Photoshop 2026 27.6 and earlier; Photoshop 2025 26.11.6 and earlier
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-76199, CVE-2026-82007, CVE-2026-82006, CVE-2026-75631, CVE-2026-82005, CVE-2026-75863, CVE-2026-75862, and CVE-2026-75771
- **Severity:** Critical; CVSS 7.8 to 8.6
- **Description:** Eight memory-safety and search-path vulnerabilities could result in arbitrary code execution, generally requiring local access or user interaction.
- **Why relevant:** Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Creative Cloud are explicitly monitored.
- **Source:** [Adobe APSB26-130](https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/photoshop/apsb26-130.html)

#### 8. Cisco UCS and UCS-based appliances: Secure Boot bypass

- **Affected product/component:** Multiple Cisco UCS servers and UCS-based appliances
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-20293
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 7.1
- **Description:** A user with valid low-privilege credentials, or an attacker with physical access, can use UEFI Shell memory-write commands to bypass Secure Boot validation and execute unauthorized software.
- **Why relevant:** Cisco UCS is explicitly monitored.
- **Source:** [Cisco advisory cisco-sa-ucs-uefi-sb-bypass-eb6xC5GW](https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-ucs-uefi-sb-bypass-eb6xC5GW)

### Possible match needing review

#### ONLYOFFICE ownCloud integration plugin SSRF

- **Affected product/component:** ONLYOFFICE ownCloud integration plugin 9.12
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-84282
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated by CERT/CC
- **Description:** An authenticated administrator can supply a crafted Document Server URL and make the ownCloud server send requests to localhost or internal hosts, enabling internal reconnaissance and port scanning.
- **Why it may be relevant:** ONLYOFFICE is monitored, but the inventory does not confirm that the ownCloud integration plugin is deployed.
- **Source:** [CERT/CC VU#943094](https://www.kb.cert.org/vuls/id/943094)

### MongoDB ecosystem sweep

A dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major maintained libraries. No fresh, credible MongoDB-related disclosure was verified inside this scan window. MongoDB's latest authoritative alert entries were dated September 3; September 8 Server CVE records reviewed were published before the cutoff and were excluded.

### Closing

Immediate review is recommended for Windows and Chrome because active exploitation is confirmed. Prioritize exposure and patch-level checks for SQL Server, Adobe Acrobat/Reader, Photoshop, and Cisco UCS next. Confirm whether the ONLYOFFICE ownCloud plugin is deployed before treating that possible match as an affected asset.
